fusions.name: Reaping Lash
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone ahead of you, dealing 8 damage to everything caught in it. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Reaped Wound
fusions.desc: Throws a curved blade that deals 14 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Gleaned Breath
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Cut
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
